text: Take a slow breath in, and let it go.
Let your body settle into this moment, as if the space around you is widening, inside
Inside you there is a steady place where inspiration rises naturally, a quiet inner space that
becomes clearer as your mind softens and your body relaxes.
Bring your awareness there now.
You don't have to reach for it, you only need to become aware of the space inside you
that can feel it.
Take another slow breath and allow your attention to open as your awareness continues to expand.
Imagine a calm, expansive field, warm, spacious, alive, a field where ideas form naturally
way, where inspiration rises with ease.
Let your breath connect you to it.
Take a deep breath and sense that field gently brightening.
Exhale, and feel your body relax into it.
This is the universal creative source, the quiet intelligence that moves through life,
thought, through imagination.
You are part of it.
You always have been.
Bring your awareness to the center of your chest, as if a small spark were glowing there.
Be warm, open.
With each breath, feel that spark responding to the creative field around you.
A natural resonance, a gentle alignment.
Don't have to be chased.
When you are connected, they rise on their own.
Take one more slow inhale and feel that connection strengthen, clear, calm, quietly powerful,
and let the exhale carry you into a state of openness for whatever wants to emerge next.
Your creativity is awake, aligned and connected.
this awareness with you into your day.
